description: Source code for handling Blue Zones in font hinting, part of FreeType project, specifically for Adobe's CFF engine. Contains functions for initializing blue zones and capturing hints within zones.

methods.name: cf2_blues_init
methods.description: Initializes the CF2_Blues structure with font-specific blue zone data, applying heuristics for em box and family zones, and adjusting scale and hints accordingly.

methods.name: cf2_blues_capture
methods.description: Attempts to capture a stem hint edge within the blue zones, adjusting position based on overshoot suppression and other heuristics, and locking the hint edges if captured.
